aiSummary.oneLiner: Daily opportunity brief aggregating startup signals for indie hackers.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: BuilderPulse is a curated daily brief that synthesizes over 300 live public signals from platforms like Hacker News and GitHub to identify high-conviction product opportunities for indie developers. Instead of providing an overwhelming feed of news, it isolates exactly one viable software product idea per day and backs it up with concrete market demand signals (like search volume surges or pain points in comments). It is designed to bridge the gap between identifying market gaps and deciding what to build next.
keyFeatures: Single Daily Idea: Distills massive amounts of internet noise into one focused, actionable product idea per day.
Signal Aggregation: Cross-validates over 300 data points daily from major developer and tech communities.
Trend Tracking: Links specific product suggestions to concrete metrics, such as search surges or viral comment threads.
Bilingual Delivery: Offers content and archives in both English and Chinese.
Actionable Context: Explains not just what to build, but specifically "why now" based on immediate market conditions.
